'''Kroh'dalla''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in [[Kala'din (city)|Kala'din]]. Second supervisor to the [[Ryll Master]], Kroh'dalla became greedy and sold the location of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] mines to the [[spice merchant]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Brophys]].
